g.text: Cross-source replication: does “neuroscience leans on AI; AI does not lean back” hold across data sources?

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #9aa0a6

g.text: Each column is an independent re-derivation. Compare the SHAPE down each row (rising vs. flat) — not levels across columns (each source has its own classifier vintage / field definition).

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #9aa0a6

g.text: Metric: cross-field references per 1,000 classified references, per (field, year). Shaded = 95% cluster-bootstrap CI over sampled papers (snapshot is the full population, no sampling CI). Dotted line = 2014. Sources: OpenAlex snapshot (Mar 2026) & live API (May 2026), topic-based; Semantic Scholar API, venue-based, non-elided subset. · R. Duarte / The Transmitter
